name: step3_pcr_m_smoke_incident_001
failure_stage: after in-memory reference cache construction and before cache persistence, optimizer construction, or training loop
diagnosis: The trainer called the wrong serialization module. step3_pcr_mw_common.write_jsonl is already used and tested by the packet and feasibility stages.
recovery: Change only the serializer namespace and permit one full PCR_M_mean restart in a new output directory after commit and push. Do not start PCR_MW before the repaired PCR_M smoke completes.
